LanguageData.Gun_TRG-22_RWP.description: The TRG-22 is a precision bolt-action sniper rifle, designed for long-range marksmanship and accuracy. Renowned for its high muzzle velocity and exceptional range, this rifle is perfect for taking down targets from a distance. Although it has a slower rate of fire and requires careful aim, the TRG-22 delivers devastating single-shot damage, making it an excellent choice for skilled marksmen on the battlefield.
